shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in an emerald sweater sits in the plant-side window seat and speaks about the meeting schedule, a woman in a mustard cardigan sits in the plant-side aisle seat, and a man in a burgundy hoodie sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a navy blazer enters, takes the counter-side window seat, and asks a question, and the woman in an emerald sweater answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald sweater asks about the deadline, and the man in a burgundy hoodie replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
